Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq are the openers for Pakistan. Jayden Seales to start with the ball. One slip in place.
...The Chase...

Now the score is a big one and the wicket is gripping a touch. It won’t be an easy chase for the hosts if Windies bowl well but they have quite an inexperienced attack. The second half can be an exciting one. Stay tuned…

Shai Hope is up for a chat. He says they never played in this condition. Adds that some balls were staying low when bowled into the pitch. Shares that he just wanted to capitalize on his form, and put on a good score. On the wicket, he says there was a bit of turn but a decent one to bat on. The bowlers need to keep it straight and hopes for a couple of early wickets.

The Pakistan bowling was not at its best! They bowled well in parts. Haris Rauf got 4 but was very expensive. Except for Shadab Khan, every other bowler will not be happy with their economy. They just seemed a touch rusty.

The start wasn’t the best for them as they lost Mayers early but Brooks and Hope laid the foundation with a brilliant partnership. Brook fell but Hope continued. He got to his ton. When Hope and Powell were batting 320 looked possible but wickets at the end meant they have fallen well short of that mark.

A strong batting display then from Windies and they have justified their decision of batting first. Yes, they were in a position to get more than they did but they still have a very competitive score on the board.
Fuller one this time, Hayden Walsh pulls it to mid-wicket for a brace. WINDIES END ON 305/8.
On off, this is guided towards point for one.
Hayden Walsh walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! On middle and full, Akeal Hosein looks to flick it but doesn't connect well. It goes high and towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Hasan Ali runs forward and takes a superb tumbling catch. Second wicket of this over for Haris Rauf.
Commentary.Howout: c Hasan Ali b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, Akeal Hosein looks to swing it but misses.
Alzarri Joseph walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Romario Shepherd goes and it could certainly make a difference of 15-20 runs as he had the ability to make the last over a big one. On middle, Romario Shepherd tries for a maximum but mistimes this one straight towards the fielder on long on. Mohammad Nawaz does no mistake and gets safe hands on it.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! And that brings up 300 for the Windies. That was a maximum the moment it hit his bat. On middle, Romario Shepherd flicks it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
SIX! Shaheen Afridi tries for a yorker but ends up bowling it under the bat. Akeal Hosein smaks it down the ground and over long on for a maximum.
Fuller and on off, Romario Shepherd guides it towards mid-wicket for one.
Yorker and on middle, Romario Shepherd blocks this one out.
Sticks to his length and on leg this time, Romario Shepherd looks to swing it but misses again.
Fuller and down the middle, Akeal Hosein defends it back towards Shaheen Afridi.
Goes fuller and outside off, Akeal Hosein looks to slap it towards point but misses.
Outside off and full, Romario Shepherd moves to his off side and gives a mighty swing but misses. The ball goes through and towards the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, Romario Shepherd tries to hit it but misses.
Full and outside off, Romario Shepherd looks to flick it bit gets a thick inside edge. The ball races towards fine leg and they get a couple of runs.
Length ball on middle, Akeal Hosein eases it to mid off for a quick single.
Outside off, defended towards short third man.
On a length and on middle, Romario Shepherd guides it towards mid-wicket for a single. He wanted a couple but was sent back.
OUT! CAUGHT! A low full works for Shaheen Afridi. Rovman Powell looks to go for a biggie but the ball hits the upper part of the bat and Mohammad Haris with safe hands at the mid-wicket region.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Haris b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: Akeal Hosein walls out to bat!
Flicked a fuller ball towards square leg for a brace.
FOUR! On middle, Romario Shepherd looks to flick it but gets a leading edge. The ball races towards third man for a boundary.
Outside off, Romario Shepherd lofts it towards long off. Good fielding but poor assistance there. It was just a single but they ended up giving three.
Fuller and on middle, Rovman Powell flicks it to square leg for a single.
Full and on off, Romario Shepherd hits it towards long off for one.
FOUR! Good over for Windies. 15 off it. On leg, Rovman Powell uses the pace of the ball and flicks it through fine leg for a two bounce boundary.
On off, Romario Shepherd guides it towards covers and takes a quick single.
Fuller and wide outside off, Romario Shepherd looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
SIX! That is huge. On a length and on off, Romario Shepherd makes room for himself and flicks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Length ball on off, Rovman Powell guides it towards point for one.
Shorter and outside leg, Rovman Powell looks to pull it but misses. Wide called.
On a good length and on middle, Rovman Powell defends it back towards the bowler.
Length ball on middle, this is guided towards mid-wicket for one.

Not out! Length and on leg, Romario Shepherd looks to block it but misses as the ball hits his pads. A loud appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. Pakistan goes for the review. Ball Tracking shows that the impact was umpire's call. Not out.
Review! Pakistan take a review for LBW! UltraEdge shows no bat there. Ball Tracking shows the impact is umpire's call. Not out.
On a length and on middle, Rovman Powell plays it towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and down the leg side, Rovman Powell looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
FOUR! On leg, fuller. Rovman Powell flicks it past short fine leg for a boundary.
On middle, eased towards third man for a single.

Not out! On leg, Rovman Powell flicks it towards short fine leg for a quick single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the keeper's end and the decision is taken upstairs. Replay shows that Romario Shepherd just managed to make in his crease. Not out.
Is that run out? The replay shows the batter had his bat inside the crease when the bails are off. Not out it is.
Outside off, this is played towards off side for one.
FOUR! Well-timed from Rovman Powell. On off, this is lofted towards long off for a one bounce boundary.
Fuller on middle, Romario Shepherd flicks it to mid on for one.
Romario Shepherd walks out.

OUT! BOWLED! End of an excellent innings from Shai Hope. On off and full, Hope gets on his knees and looks to work on the leg side gets a bottom edge and the ball hits the timber behind. He walks back with a standing ovation.
On middle, Rovman Powell pushes it to covers for a quick single. A direct hit but Powell has nothing to worry about. He was well in.
FOUR! Low full toss down the leg side, Rovman Powell uses the pace of the ball and gives a fine tickle. The ball races behind the fence for a boundary.
Full and on middle, Shai Hope eases it to mid on and rotates the strike.
Shorter and on middle, Rovman Powell looks to flick it but misses.
On middle, Shai Hope guides it to point for one.
FOUR! Full and on middle, Shai Hope bangs it over mid-wicket. The ball just landed before the fence for a one bounce boundary.
On off, defended out solidly.
FOUR! Good shot! Outside off and on a good length, Shai Hope gets on his knees and lofts it over long off for a one-bounce boundary.
Length and on leg, Rovman Powell flicks it to fine leg for one.
A dot to end the over. Tossed up on middle, Shai Hope defends it back towards Shadab Khan.
On middle, Rovman Powell flicks it towards square leg for one.
On middle, blocked out solidly.
On middle, this is flicked towards square leg for one.
Outside off, defended to covers for a quick single.
Tossed up on middle, Shai Hope flicks it it towards square leg for one.
On leg, Shai Hope looks to slog sweep it but gets a leading edge. The ball rolls towards third man. Excellent stop near the boundary line. Single taken.
Fuller and down the leg side, Shai Hope flicks it towards fine leg for a brace. This is good running between the wickets.
On middle, Rovman Powell flicks it towards square leg for one.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Rovman Powell ducks under it.
Full and on middle, this is flicked towards square leg.
On a length and on off, Shai Hope looks to pull it but doesn't get enough power on it. The ball races towards mid-wicket. Single taken.
Powerplay 3! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
A wrong 'un, around off. Hope steps forward and tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter and on off, drilled down to long on for a run.
Too full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Who will walk out now? Rovman Powell comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Khan strikes and sends back King! Khan flights this up, full and on off, spinning away. King leans but fails to reach the pitch of the ball. He chips it straight back to Shadab who takes a dolly. A timely wicket for Pakistan, they can pile the pressure from here on.
Slightly short and outside off, Hope punches it to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven to long off for a single.
SIX! Now, he'll play with full freedom! This is full and on middle. Hope hangs back and heaves it to long on for a biggie.
Overpitched and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Full and on off, nips back in. King forces it to mid on.
Touch full and outside off. King knocks it to point.
Another single as this is hit to deep point.

FOUR! CENTURY FOR SHAI HOPE! What a knock from the opener! A well-deserved one! Batted beautifully! This is full and outside off. He drives it through covers for a boundary. Jumps in excitement and celebrates his knock by raising his bat.
Too full and outside off. Hope drives it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Shai again blocks it. Nervous 90s for him.
Quicker through the air and on middle. Hope prods and blocks it.
Full, quicker and outside off. Hope looks to drive but is beaten.
Shorter and outside off. King works it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shadab Khan back into the attack.
This one spins away, full and outside off. King plays the wrong line as he tries to push at it.
This one is outside off, on a yorker-length. Hope looks to squeeze it out but fails to connect.
Another dot! Length and outside off. Hope drives it straight to cover.
On middle, on a length. Hope nudges it to mid-wicket.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single. 200 up for West Indies.
A length ball, around middle, jags back in. King fails to tuck it away and gets hit on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW but that was clearly going down.
Length ball, on middle, tucked past mid-wicket for a single.
Brandon King comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ends the over really well. Haris Rauf gets his man. Length ball outside off, Nicholas Pooran pulls it but mistimes the shot. Khushdil Shah, the man at square leg takes a comfortable catch. The skipper walks away in disappointment.
Commentary.Howout: c Khushdil Shah b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball angling into the batter, this is defended to point for one.
Shorter in length and on middle, Shai Hope looks to play at it but misses.
On middle, guided towards square leg for a quick single.
SIX! Bang. Nicholas Pooran is going after it. Slightly shorter from Haris Rauf, Pooran pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Back of a length on leg, Shai Hope flicks it to square leg for one.
Around off, fuller and Pooran turns it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, outside off. Pooran gets back to block it out.
Flatter and on off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Pushes it quicker, on middle, eased down to long on for one.
SIX! Again in the slot, Nawaz has not learned his lessons! This is easy stuff for Pooran! Full ball and again Pooran slog-sweeps it over deep square leg for a maximum.
SIX! BANG! Full and in the slot, around off. Pooran kneels and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. First one of the game.
This one almost touches 144 clicks, on a length and outside off. Hope looks to push at it but misses.
Another bouncer, on middle. Hope gets on top of it and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Slight halt in play as the bouncer hits Hope straight on his helmet. The physio is out to have a look! Rightly so as that seemed a nasty blow. Hope seems fine.

Ouchh! A short ball, well-directed on middle at 139 clicks. The ball does not bounce much and hits Hope on the helmet as he tries to duck under it. Babar Azam runs quickly to check him and a mandatory concussion protocol will follow.
QUICK SINGLE! Length ball, outside off. Pooran punches it to mid off and takes a sharp single.
Length ball, outside off. Hope tries to drive on the up but gets an outside edge to third man for one.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full and down the leg side. Hope just helps it away to fine leg for a boundary. He moves into the 90s.
DRINKS!
This one spins into Pooran, around off. He flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off. Blocked out.
Too full and on off. Pooran sweeps it to square leg. Nawaz appeals but it came off the bat.
A single as Hope drives this to long off.
Flatter and outside off. Hope punches it covers.
Full and on off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Short ball wide from the batsman. Nicholas Pooran  tries to work it towards the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowled on middle and leg but quicker this time, hits Nicholas Pooran on his pads. Massive appeal but umpire doesn't seem interested.
Ball drifts into the batsman. Pooran plays it watchfully to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off stump. Shai Hope comes down the wicket and punches it to long off for a single.
Leg stump line. Batsman tries to play it off his pad but misses and goes to fine leg for a leg bye.
Tossed up on a good line. Shai Hope takes a stride and drives through cover for a single.
Nicholas Pooran is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a terrific catch! Something special was needed to break this stand and it is provided by Shadab Khan. Sensational stuff. End of a solid knock from Brooks. He can consider himself a tad unlucky. Windies were looking to step on the gas. Brooks brings out the slog sweep. The length is shortened. There is extra bounce too. It goes off the top edge towards short third man. The fielder runs to his left, dives and takes a one handed stunner.
Commentary.Howout: c Shadab Khan b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! This is brilliant batting! Picking the gaps perfectly. Steps out. This time comes inside the line and whips it over mid-wicket. Two boundaries in the over now.
Another run! Floated up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Sensible stuff! Now takes one after the boundary as this is hit through covers.
FOUR! Elegant! Wonderful from Hope. He makes use of his feet, stays leg side of the ball and lifts it over covers for a wonderful boundary. Good start to the over.
Outside off again, Shamarh Brooks guides it to point.
Length ball outside off, Shamarh Brooks looks to drive it but misses.
Tossed up outside off, Shai Hope uses his feet and drives it towards long off. Single taken.
Shorter this time but still wide. Shai Hope cant get this away and finds the cover fielder.
Short wide delivery. Shai Hope cuts it staright to the point fielder.
FOUR! Shai Hope is in scintillating form! Full and tossed up outside off, Shai Hope gets on his knees and slams it square of long on for a beautiful boundary!
Shadab Khan to bowl now.
Gives it air, Hope leans into this and eases it down to long on for one.
Another one on the shorter side, this is hit down to long on for another single.
A single now as this is nudged away from mid-wicket.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Picked his spot really well! This is flatter and on middle, Hope toes down on one knee and hits it over mid-widket, no one in the deep, boundary.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! These slower deliveries not working for Hasan Ali. It is a fuller delivery which Shamarh Brooks seemed like he was waiting for, smashes it over mid on for boundary! West indies are in charge now!
Shorter delivery outside off. Brooks knocks the ball to mid off.
Good length delivery on the stumps. Shai Hope works it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! West Indies are getting a move on here. Full and on middle, Shai Hope doesn't time it really well but still manages to get it straight past mid off for another boundary!
WIDE! Short and outside off this time. It is well over the head of the batsman and declared wide!
WIDE! Goes for the slower delivery once again but misses his line. Pushed it down the leg side for a wide.
Slower delivery outside off stump. Shai Hope is decieved by the pace and misses the ball.

FOUR! That's been dispatched with authority! Hasan Ali pitches it in line around the off stump and Shai Hope lofts it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary! Shai Hope is looking good here!
A single to end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Good tight over from Nawaz so far! Good stop too. On off, this is pushed towards cover. The fielder dives to his right and stops it. He saves a run.
Swept hard, it goes through square leg for one.
This time he does hit it to cover but finds the fielder.
That held and turned off the surface! Shorter and around off, this lands and spins away. Brooks looks to play it through covers but gets an inside edge onto the body.
He had to hit that and did so really well! On middle, Brooks gets the sweep out. It is hit through square leg. The fielder in the deep, runs to his right, slides and keeps it down to two.
Good length delivery on middle. Shai Hope tries to drive but only manages to find mid-wicket.
Short ball and tucks the batsman in. Shai Hope lets it go.
Shorter delivery pitching in line. Turns it towards mid-wicket.
Good length angling into the batter. Shamarh Brooks plays it off his legs through square leg for a single.
On a length and on off. Hope misses his flick. The keeper fumbles to collect and a bye is conceded.
Around the wicket from Shaheen Afridi. Full and angling into the batter. Shamarh Brooks plays it off his pads to deep square leg for a single.
Two dots to end but a good over for the Windies. Flatter and outside off, this is guided to point.
Gives it air, on middle, this is driven back to the bowler.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
FOUR! Should have done better, the fielder. On the pads, this is swept towards short fine leg. Shaheen dives over the ball and it goes to the fence. Runs now flowing for the Windies.
Slightly shorter but closer to the off pole. Brooks looks to cut but chops it to covers.
A fumble and two taken! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point. The fielder in the deep fails to stop it cleanly. Two taken.
Mohammad Nawaz is back on.
Back of a length and on leg, Shamarh Brooks pulls it to fine leg for one.
Shorter one again, Shamarh Brooks ducks under it.
Shorter and on off, Shai Hope waits for the ball and plays an upper cut towards third man. Excellent fielding at third man region saving a boundary for his team. Single taken.
Full and on off, it is pushed to mid off for a single. The 100-run stand is up.
Slightly short of length on off stump, played through backward point for a single.

FOUR!! That is fifty for Shai Hope! What a shot to bring it up! Shaheen Afridi pitches it straight on middle. Shai Hope plays it straight down the ground for a boundary and brings up his half century.
Shaheen Afridi (4-1-11-1) is back into the attack.
On middle, Shai Hope guides it to covers. Single taken.

FIFTY FOR BROOKS! His third fifty in ODI cricket. A very mature knock from Brooks! This is on a length and outside off. Brooks dabs it to backward point for a single. He raises his bat and soaks all the applause from his teammates.
FOUR BYES! Shorter and on middle, Shamarh Brooks ducks under it. The keeper couldn't reach it as well and the ball races behind the boundary line.
On middle, defended to mid on. Hope tries for a risky single but Shamarh Brooks sent him back.
FOUR! Shorter and on middle, Shamarh Brooks looks to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball goes towards long leg for a boundary. Not a shot where he wanted to play but he got the result he wanted.
On a good length and on middle, Shai Hope plays it to mid on. A quick single taken. This is good running between the wickets.
A dot to end the over. On middle, driven straight to the fielder at covers.
Tossed up delivery, Shai Hope drives it to covers. Good fielding by the fielder at covers. Single taken.
On middle blocked out.
Outside off again, Hope drives it but straight to the fielder at covers.
Full and on off, Shamarh Brooks guides it through point and rotates the strike.
Outside off, Shamarh Brooks eases it towards covers.
Shorter and on middle, Hope leaves it alone.
On a good length and on middle, Shai Hope defends it towards square leg.
Shorter in length and on middle, Shai Hope ducks under it.
Outside off again, Shamarh Brooks miscues his flick towards mid off. Single taken.
On a length and outside off, Shai Hope drives it towards covers for one.
On a length and on off, Shai Hope blocks it towards mid on.
Full and on middle, Shai Hope eases it towards mid on for one.
Tossed up on middle, Shai Hope blocks it back towards Shadab Khan.
Tossed up delivery, Shamarh Brooks eases it to mid on for one.
Outside off this time, Shai Hope drives it to covers for one.
On middle, played at mid off for one.
Tossed up on middle with a hint of turn, Shamarh Brooks eases it to covers.
Low full toss on leg, Shamarh Brooks eases it to mid on and gets a quick single. He keeps his strike.
On off and full, Shai Hope cuts it to point for one.
Outside off, Shai Hope creams it towards covers for a brace.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Shamarh Brooks eases it to covers and takes a quick single.
Fuller and on leg, Shai Hope flicks it to square leg and rotates the strike.
Touch fuller and outside off, Shai Hope looks to drive it but misses.
Fuller and on leg, Shamarh Brooks sweeps it but straight to the fielder at short fine leg.
On a length and outside off, Shai Hope cuts it through point and rotates the strike.
Outside off, defended to point.
Tossed up delivery, Shamarh Brooks eases it to point for one.
Fuller and on off, Shai Hope drives it towards extra covers and gets a single.
Outside off, guided towards covers.
Good over from Hasan Ali, just two runs of it. This is on middle and on length, Shamarh Brooks blocks it back towards the bowler.
Outside off, drives towards mid on.
Fuller one this time and on middle, Shai Hope flicks it to square leg and rotates the strike.
Length ball wide outside off, Shai Hope looks to drive it but gets a bottom edge as the ball bounce back towards the keeper.
Length and outside off, Shai Hope looks to slash at it but misses.
On a length and outside off, Shamarh Brooks looks to guide it to the off side but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces towards the third man region. Single taken.

Drinks! West Indies have fought well after losing Mayers early on. Hope and Brooks have done well to build a stand but will look to change the gears now. Pakistan will look to keep asking questions and look for breakthroughs. The middle session will be mostly about the spinners and how West Indies manages to deal with them..
On a good length and outside off, Shamarh Brooks cuts it straight towards the fielder at extra covers. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, Shai Hope drives it to covers and rotates the strike.
Touch full and on middle, Shai Hope blocks it back towards Shadab Khan.
Goes full and on off, Shai Hope defends it solidly.
Similar to the last delivery, Shamarh Brooks again drives it to mid on for one.
Tossed up and on middle, Shai Hope drives it to mid on for a single.
Length ball outside off, Shai Hope opens up and guides it through covers. Single taken.
Sticks to bowling it on middle, Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Fuller and on middle again, Shai Hope flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, guided towards mid on for a single.
On middle, this is defended back towards Mohammad Nawaz.
Tossed up on middle, Shamarh Brooks defends it out solidly.
On a length and on off, Shamarh Brooks smashes it straight towards the fielder at covers.
On middle, this is played towards the mid on region.
Shadab Khan bowls it outside off, Shamarh Brooks guides it to point for one.
Low full toss on off, Shai Hope drives it to long off for a single.
On middle this time, Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards square leg for one.
Tossed up outside off, Shamarh Brooks drives it towards extra covers for a brace.
Shadab Khan is into the attack.
This is full and way outside off. Hope drives it hard but straight to cover.
Length ball, outside off, it is pushed to long off for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! On middle, Shamarh Brooks looks to drive it but gets an outside edge. The ball races towards third man for a boundary.
On middle, defended.
Tossed up outside off, driven through covers. Good try from the fielder diving to his left but just manages to get his hand on it. Single taken.
Outside off, guided towards third man for one.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Shai Hope with a beautiful cover drive, hits it through covers and the ball races away for a boundary. That was excellently timed from Shai Hope.
Goes full and on off, Shai Hope tries to play it to third man but ends up chopping it back to the keeper.
Outside off, Shamarh Brooks guides it towards the third man region for one.
On off, Shai Hope steers it towards the third man region for one.
Shorter and on middle, Shai Hope moves forward to play at it but leaves it through towards the keeper in the end.
Touch fuller and on middle, Shamarh Brooks pushes it to mid-wicket.
This is full and drifting on middle. Brooks looks to flick but closes his bat face too early, he gets a leading edge, in the air and to deep cover. Two runs.
Flatter and on off, Shai Hope eases it towards covers and rotates the strike.
Full and outside off, Shai Hope cuts it to point. He wanted a single but his partner sends him back.
On middle, driven towards long off for one.
Tossed up on leg, Shamarh Brooks sweeps it to short fine leg.
Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Just a single from the over then! Good comeback from Rauf after going for 8 in his first one! Length and just outside off. Brooks opens the face of the bat and plays it to third man for a single.

Five dots in a row! Good work from Rauf! This is on a length and angling down. Brooks looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the keeper and Brooks looks for a single but is sent back.
On a length and on middle. Brooks chips it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Shamarh knocks it to backward point.
Slants a length ball, on middle. Brooks works it to mid-wicket.
Length and on middle, played back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle. Brooks drills it to the right of mid on for a single.
Drops it short and outside off. Brooks hangs back and cuts it but straight to the point fielder.
This is full and on off. Hope makes room and drives it to covers for a single.
Full again, Hope is happy to defend it out.
Full and on off. Blocked out.

Was there an edge? It looks like there was a bit of bat on it. Will count as a drop! Short and outside off, spinning a bit away. Brooks looks to cut but gets an outside edge to the keeper, Mohammad Rizwan who fails to collect it cleanly. The ball rolls to short third man for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz comes into the attack.
Two runs to end the over! Fuller and on middle. Hope flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Classic shot! A half-volley, outside off. Hope drives it crisply through covers, in the gap for a boundary. Hope looks in fine touch.
Length ball on top of off. Brooks stays back and guides it to third man for a single.
Around off, on a length. Brooks turns it to square leg.
A sharp single! Fuller and on off. Hope wrists it to mid on and scampers across for a quick single.
On a length and on the pads, tucked to square leg.
Haris Rauf comes into the attack.
Touch fuller and on off. Brooks looks to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge to covers.
Full ball, around off. Brooks plays it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Glorious shot! Too full from Afridi, on middle. Shamarh Brooks flicks it to square leg and it races away to the fence in no time.
Length ball, on off, at 137.2 kph. Blocked out.
Length ball, shaping away, outside off. Brooks looks to cut it but misses.
A pacy short ball, on leg. Brooks sits under it.
FOUR! Such a good over but this last ball just ruins it a bit! On a length and outside off, width was there and Hope makes most of it as he cuts it past point for a boundary.
Short in length and outside off. Hope hops and punches it straight to point.
Length ball, on off, it stays low and was slower as well. Hope miscues his drive to mid-wicket.
A single! Outside off, on a length. Brooks strokes it to the left of point for a sharp single.
A length ball, around off, nipping back in sharply. Brooks looks to work it away on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Was going down.
Length ball, outside off. Brooks punches it to cover.
Outside off, on a length. Hope drives it to short cover. A maiden from Shaheen Afridi.
Another defensive shot from Hope! Length ball, around off, tight from Afridi and Hope responds with a straight defensive bat.
On a length and on middle. Hope stays back to again block it.
Around off. Blocked out to point.
On a length and on off. Hope defends it out on the deck.
Good shot but for no run! A length ball, outside off. Hope drives it but straight to the man at mid off.
11 runs off the over! Around off, on a length. Brooks works it to point.
Fuller and outside off. Brooks looks to push it but inner edges it through the diving mid-wicket fielder for a brace.
FOUR! Two in a row! Good start by Brooks! Short of a length and on middle. Brooks is quick onto his back foot as he pulls it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Brooks is off the mark with a boundary! This is full and on middle. Brooks flicks it nicely past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Touch fuller and on off, pushed to mid off. No run there.
Full ball, on middle. Hope tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! Length ball, slanting across. Brooks looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Brooks and Hope probably hold the key for the Windies. Both come in in good form and have began well too.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Early breakthrough for Pakistan and their prime bowler, a bowler who is in red-hot form strikes. Afridi serves a juicy low dipping full toss, outside off. Mayers leans and looks to drive but his bat turns and the ball goes off the inner half of the bat, straight back to Afridi who catches it easily. Afridi celebrates but Mayers holds his position and the umpires refer it upstairs to check. The replay confirms that Mayers has to walk back. Superb start for Pakistan. Shamarh Brooks is the new man in.
Is that out? A caught and bowled decision and Shaheen Afridi looks confident. It looks out in slow motion. The third umpire feels the same and Kyle Mayers is a goner.
On a length and outside off. Hope taps it to third man for a single.
This one keeps on going away with the angle, on a length. Hope tries to pull but misses.
A bouncer at 136.6 kph, on middle. Hope evades it by swaying away.
On a length and on off. Hope hangs back and knocks it to covers.
Full ball on middle, it is driven straight to mid off.
Full and on off. Mayers mistimes his drive to mid on. Again not timed that well by Mayers.
Short in length and around off. Mayers stands tall and opens the face of the bat to guide it through backward point for a brace. Good fielding in the deep by Afridi.
Fuller and around off, the ball is coming a bit late. Mayers looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle. on a length. Blocked out.
Ali starts with a short of a length, on the hips. Mayers looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Hasan Ali will bowl from the other end.
A dot to end the over! Afridi bangs a bouncer, around off. Hope thinks to ramp it away but lets it through in the end.
FOUR! Beautiful shot from Hope! This is overpitched and across, around off. Hope drives it crisply through covers for a boundary.
Touch fuller and on off. Hope drives it to mid off.
Tight from Afridi! On a length and on middle. Hope defends it on the front foot.
On a length and on middle. Mayers nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
A length ball, outside off, shaping a bit away. Hope looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge and to third man for a single. West Indies are underway.

We are all set for the action. The players of Pakistan are out in a huddle before their spread out. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers are the openers for the Windies. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball. West Indies players take the knee to support the BLM movement.
The players from both teams line up for their respective national anthems. It is West Indies' first followed by Pakistan's.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Mohammad Haris, Khushdil Shah, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they will BAT first!

Both the sides have won their last series. Pakistan managed to beat the Aussies here at home whereas, the Windies won their overseas tour. The hosts will be pretty confident but the Windies are a side which can never be taken lightly. A lot of interesting battles to look forward to. Who do you think will start the series with a win? Stay tuned for the toss in a bit…It is not just the battle between the players but also with the sun as it will not be an easy task for the players to play under the scorching heat.
